_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Uyimdlali {player_id} kwi-Tic Tac Toe.
Injongo yakho kukwazi ukunqanda amathathu angaphezulu (ngokwezintlobo, ngokwemihla, nangokwezidumbu) kwi bhoja.
Kwesikhathi sokudlala, uyakufunza ukuthabatha inombolo yecela (0-8) uyifunayo ukuyithabatha kwi mark yakho iyaphi.
Njengoko, '[4]' ithabatha imark yakho kwi selu ephambili kwibhoja.
Njengomdlali {player_id}, uyakubakho '{symbol}', wakwimpikiswano yakho '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ayisiyo iseli esebenzayo. Kufuneka ibe phakathi ko-0 no-8.

game_action.placed: Mdlali {player_id} wathabatha isithombe sakhe ({symbol}) kwi selu {cell}.
